title: Days Past Due and the Pocketwire Advance Card Repayment Share — Collections Timing Chart
content:
The days a Pocketwire Advance line has been past due shape its card repayment share. The days past due are counted in calendar days from the date the line became past due, as its past-due-since date records it, to the handling date. When they are at most 14, 2 points are added to the share for each day by which they fall short of 14; when they are more than 14 but at most 30, the share is multiplied by 1.1; when they are more than 30, the share is used as it stands. A point is one percentage point of the share.

**Place of the treatment.** The days-past-due treatment acts on the card repayment share once every point it takes has been added to it; the share so treated then acts once on what the line owes, and only the result is rounded.

## Timing chart

| Days past due | Treatment of the share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | 2 points added for each day short of 14 |
| 15 to 30 | Multiplied by 1.1 |
| 31 or more | Used as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical share of 40 percent before the treatment)

| Days past due | Days short of 14 | Share after the treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 14 | 68 percent |
| 10 | 4 | 48 percent |
| 14 | 0 | 40 percent |
| 15 | — | 44 percent |
| 30 | — | 44 percent |
| 31 | — | 40 percent |

With a treated share of 48 percent and a hypothetical 150.00 owed, the share acts once on what the line owes: 72.00.
